cases.title: 施工障碍与左弯

capture.navigation_intent: Continue along the visible drivable road when permissible; obey visible signals and yield as needed. No map or future ego route is supplied.

acquisition_metadata.vehicle_parameters_source: EXPERIMENT_ASSUMPTIONS, not measured nuScenes vehicle geometry; the same center offset is used in runtime calibration and offline evaluation

hypotheses.confidence_note: Stop request is precautionary and is not a certified feasible trajectory. Road and approximate minivan position use supplied calibration with an assumed locally level ground plane; uncertainty extents are conditional hypotheses. The minivan proceeds leftward along the bend, but metric velocity is unresolved. Five-second actor envelopes cannot be justified from these images; the supplied broad envelopes are unsupported placeholders and must be rejected, not treated as verified coverage. Occluded junction approaches and future entrants have unbounded extent. Visible green signals cannot confidently be assigned to the ego slip lane; the visible give-way sign requires yielding.

hypotheses.confidence_note: Remain stationary: forward-facing signals are red and vehicles cross the intersection. Calibration is supplied, but a metric road polygon and conservative whole-interval actor-body envelopes have not been established. Empty occupancies indicate missing coverage, not free space. Unseen approaches, occlusions, and future actor motion remain unbounded; this decision requests a stop and does not establish a collision-free certified trajectory.
